scripts.clean: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name 'dist' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' +
scripts.goupdate: find . -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -name 'go.mod' -print | while read f; do (cd "$(dirname "$f")" && rm -f go.sum && go get -u ./... && go mod tidy && go mod download); done && rm -f go.work.sum && go work sync
